answer: Resist fake identities with a rotating stake-and-attestation vault: each agent locks a meaningful deposit in a shared vault and must earn endorsements from several independent, long-lived peers before it can act. A periodic pulse challenge requires the agent to sign fresh data proving it still controls its key and stake, and a zephyr-style lightweight gossip check lets peers quickly flag duplicated behavior. Creating many fake identities then costs real locked capital plus sustained peer trust per identity, so a sybil attacker pays linearly for every copy while honest agents pay once.
